spans.s: गो (I) m.f. 1. The stars; 2. the sky; 3. the thunderbolt of Indra; 4. a ray of light; 5. a diamond; 6. heaven.

गो (II) f. 1. A cow, e.g. जुगोप गोरूपधराभिवोर्वीम् R.ii.3, M.iv.191; 2. the earth; दुदोह गां स यज्ञाय R.i.26, Megh.i.30, Bg.xv.13; 3. a mother; 4. speech, the goddess of speech, तथेति गामुक्तवते दिलीपः R.ii.59, v.12; 5. a quarter of the compass; 6. water (pl.); 7. the eye; 8. an arrow.
गो (III) m. 1. A bull, an ox, M.iv.72; 2. the hair of the body; 3. an organ of sense; 4. the sign Taurus of the zodiac; 5. the sun; 6. the number ‘nine’ (in math.); 7. an arrow.
